WF-03 Step 04 (TEST-DESIGNER): Write tests for ISS-0073.

Frontend unit test (Vitest):
File: web/src/auth/buildRedirectArgs.test.ts (new)

Test 1 — buildRedirectArgs returns realm-qualified redirect_uri when slug present:
  - Mock resolveRealmFromUrl() to return 'swiftroute'
  - Call buildRedirectArgs()
  - Assert result.redirect_uri === window.location.origin + '/auth/callback?realm=swiftroute'

Test 2 — buildRedirectArgs returns undefined when no slug:
  - Mock resolveRealmFromUrl() to return null
  - Call buildRedirectArgs()
  - Assert result === undefined

Test 3 — buildRedirectArgs encodes special characters in realm slug:
  - Mock resolveRealmFromUrl() to return 'my realm/test'
  - Assert redirect_uri contains 'my%20realm%2Ftest'

Spec doc: tests/specs/OIDC-F-02-callback-realm.md

Commit and push. Complete with next_action='Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 04b)'.

result.summary: Wrote 3 Vitest unit tests for buildRedirectArgs (OIDC-F-02). Extracted helper to oidcRedirectArgs.ts. All tests pass.
